title: If I Had the Time
label: ch:zh-if-i-had-the-time
canDo: I can say what I would do if things were different, and write six connected lines.

payoff.summary: Complete ZH-R289-review-final-289: one dialogue across the B1 core, after saying what would happen with 如果 … 就会 …, otherwise with 不然, and writing six connected lines to a friend about a trip that went wrong.
payoff.note: ZH-W289-six-lines is the core's third piece of connected-composition evidence: six lines that lean on each other, for a named reader (a friend) and a real purpose (telling them what went wrong, and what to do about it), after one controlled line (ZH-W281-one-reason) and a four-line note (ZH-W285-a-note). Pinyin inside the lines is licensed for words whose characters the book has not taught.
